reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, this is a tidy follow-up to #1916.

Only overwriting `a.model.Config.MaxTokens` when `maxTokens > 0` keeps the catalog's limit for a hand-written config that omits `maxtokens`, so Bedrock no longer gets `max_tokens: 0`. A configured value still wins, and temperature and top-p are untouched. The tests cover both the omitted and the explicit case. CI is green at `2c7f524`.

Good to merge.
